leads.notes: Combined 80 / Grade A — hottest lead this cycle. Explicit fractional legal counsel role for a FinTech investment platform, fully remote, with a STATED, market-credible rate ($115–$190/hr) — comp_credible=10, which is rare in this pipeline. Low hours (5–20/wk) is the exact flexible operator model Katie wants and leaves room to stack engagements. fund_focus=0 (investment-platform/fintech, not pure fund formation) but the investment/securities-adjacent product gives a natural bridge to fund work. The Go Fractional jobs board rotates listings — open the board and locate the live 'Fractional Legal Counsel / FinTech Investment Platform' posting to confirm freshness and apply.
